item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #VISPRSD
Issued at 06:59 PM 12 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NegrosOccidental(SanCarlosCity, Calatrava, Toboso, CityOfEscalante, CityOfTalisay), #Guimaras(Buenavista) and #Iloilo(Dumangas) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NegrosOccidental(SilayCity, EnriqueB.Magalona) and #Aklan(Altavas) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
